@file:w5/seed5.js.# VERIFY.md：銀杏散步地圖的驗收單\n\n每做完一個新功能，照這份清單:
# VERIFY.md: verification checklist for the Ginkgo Walking Map

After finishing each new feature, check this list from the top and write the results as a table.

1. The map has 12 spot markers: count the markers with class="spot" in site/index.html. There should be 12.
2. No sideways scrolling at 390 px width: switch the built-in browser to phone width. The page must not be wider than the screen.
3. All photos open: every photo file name in site/index.html must match the file names in site/photos/ exactly (upper and lower case too).
4. On a phone, the spot markers on the map must be big enough to tap with a finger.
5. On a phone, tap a marker with your finger and the photo of that spot pops up.
